summary: Frontend-only test with Playwright at 430x900 on the preview URL, plus jest. Everything in scope passed. (1) Rival Diary: the rival-diary-btn shows 'Diario Rivali · 0'. The empty screen shows rival-diary-empty and Menu goes back to the title. After injecting meta.rivals, the button shows '· 2'. The boss-dark-emperors entry shows wins 2 / W30 / KO 0 with the real image /crests/dark-emperors.png (naturalWidth 64). The miniboss-occult entry shows 1 / W5 / 1 with /crests/occult.png. Boss entries are listed before minibosses. (2) Real win: I mutated the pending W1 battle into an Occult miniboss with 1 HP, then continue -> next-wave-btn -> MANTIENI -> attack. This reached the 'MINIBOSS BATTUTO!' screen and meta.rivals['miniboss:occult'] was written (wins 1, bestWave 1, fewestKo 0). The diary showed it with the real crest after reload. (3) Rotating challenge: the Act 1 intro shows bonus-challenge-card. Seed 1153907807 % 6 = 5 gave 'Occhio da talent scout' (+40), which matches the code. Act 1 crests act-intro-crest-0/1 are real images (/crests/occult.png, /crests/royal-academy.png), not initials. hub-bonus-challenge appears in the Diario panel. Abandoning shows end-challenge-bonus with '· non riuscita, nessuna penalità'. The Sfide tab shows challenge-rotating-note. (4) Neutro: the starter Elemento filter includes choice-neutro (0 results, since the new Dark Emperors are not starters). Collection opens without a crash. engine.js handles beats:null safely. The sprites de-shadow-cimmerian, de-malcolm-night, de-thomas-feldt, canon-bomber and canon-andre-pinson exist. (5) No page errors or console errors in any flow. Jest: 122/124 pass, including rivals.test.js 3/3. The 2 failures are the known CollectionScreen and SuzetteIdentity axios mock issues.

issues: The 'DIARIO RIVALI · 0' button wraps onto 2 lines at 430px wide, which looks cramped next to the single-line buttons (minor).

action_items: Optional: shorten the diary button label or use a smaller font so it stays on one line on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js onWin anomaly branch: updateMeta({...meta, forms}) uses the closure meta. This is safe today because recordRival only changes meta for boss/miniboss encounters, which return earlier. If rival recording or other meta writes are ever combined with the anomaly path in the same handler, chain from rivalMeta to avoid lost writes.
The Neutro element is added to filters, but no Neutro starter exists, so choosing that filter always gives an empty list. Consider hiding elements that have no starters.
seed_data_creation: None persistent: browser contexts are isolated and localStorage was used per session only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To force a miniboss win: new run -> pick 3 starters (add-* buttons) -> start-run-btn -> perk-offer-skip -> act-intro-start -> click the first enabled map-node -> map-enter. Then in localStorage inazuma_rogue_run set pending.miniboss=true, bossId='occult', and enemies hp=1. Reload -> continue-run-btn -> next-wave-btn -> wait for pre-battle-keep -> attack-button. abandon-btn is inside the details panel (open it with details-btn first).
